customManagers.description: Read `# renovate:` annotations above shell `*_VERSION=` pins so a new pin needs an annotation rather than a manager of its own

packageRules.description: Exempt update types that cannot carry a release timestamp from the bake period; without this they stall forever on a pending stability check and no PR is ever opened
Hold pnpm on the 10.x line: pnpm 11.x requires Node >=22.13 and imports node:sqlite (Node >=22.5), which the CI matrix's lts/-2 Node 20 line cannot run

Hold typescript on the 6.x line: neither typescript-eslint nor ts-jest accepts 7, and both fail by refusing to load rather than by failing a check, so a bump past their peer ranges disables the eslint hook and the whole Jest suite silently. Lift once both accept 7 (typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940)

Hold tombi-pre-commit below 1.2.8: upstream ships two top-level modules without declaring py_modules, so setuptools flat-layout discovery refuses to build the hook environment and every hook goes down with it. Lift once upstream declares py_modules or moves to a src layout
